name: Sawako
source:
She is the nurse of Yoshiwara General Hospital. She often goes to night shift.
She has a fiancé and she will be married soon.
Her parents have already passed away. She also seems to have a younger brother who has a burning hand and she is still hesitant to get married.

"Well, it seems like this happened before ... It's because of my mind."
